mapper.select: /* com.portal.user.poll.qim.QustnrItemManageMapper.selectQustnrItemManageDetail */ SELECT A.QUSTNR_QESITM_ID AS qestnrQesitmId, (SELECT QESTN_CN FROM LETTNQUSTNRQESITM WHERE QUSTNR_QESITM_ID = A.QUSTNR_QESITM_ID) AS QESTNR_QESITM_CN, A.QESTNR_ID AS QESTNR_ID, (SELECT QUSTNR_SJ FROM LETTNQESTNRINFO WHERE QESTNR_ID = A.QESTNR_ID) AS QESTNR_CN, A.IEM_SN, A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID, A.IEM_CN, A.ETC_ANSWER_AT, A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID AS qestnrTmplatId, DATE_FORMAT(A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM LETTNQUSTNRIEM A WHERE A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID = #{qustnrIemId}
mapper.insert: /* com.portal.user.poll.qim.QustnrItemManageMapper.insertQustnrItemManage */ INSERT INTO LETTNQUSTNRIEM ( QUSTNR_QESITM_ID, QESTNR_ID, IEM_SN, QUSTNR_IEM_ID, IEM_CN, ETC_ANSWER_AT, QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( #{qestnrQesitmId}, #{qestnrId}, #{iemSn}, #{qustnrIemId}, #{iemCn}, #{etcAnswerAt}, #{qestnrTmplatId}, sysdate(), #{frstRegisterId}, sysdate(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
